notes.title: Japanese Localization Update
notes.content: Now you can play Smooth Game in Japanese.

notes.title: Added Settings Menu (Language) Mar 08 2023
notes.content:
Added in-game settings menu on the title screen. Now you can change languages in game. 

+) 
Currently it doesn't save settings, so it's better to change languages in your Steam library.
Follow these steps :

1. Go to your library
2. Right click on the game's title (on the left side of screen)
3. Click Properties
4. Select language tab on the left
5. Choose your preferred language

notes.title: Update Notes For Feb 22 2023
notes.content:
As someone discovered and unlocked the true power of Skateboard I had to fix it to keep the smooth world peaceful...

Skateboard won't push you back anymore but it still remains strong enough that you can't push it away.

Here's Skateboard's short comment about this update: 
"Power Overwhelming."
